Kill [[Justiciar Thommis]] and accompanying foes.

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Justiciar Thommis and accompanying foes in [[Slavers' Exile]].
* *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Thommis and accompanying foes in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Deldrimor rank|Dwarf reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
Justiciar Thommis is the left most boss on the map. 
The [[Stone Summit Warder]]s should be the first target as they have protective wards and can deal massive [[area of effect]] damage.
The other main target should be [[Stone Summit Defender]]s because they have [[Power Drain]] and [[Waste Not, Want Not]] allowing them to spam protection spells as well as interrupt
====Recommended skills====
*[[Frozen Soil]], as most of the Stone Summit have a [[resurrection]] skill.
*Anti-[[knock down]], there are large [[mob]]s of [[Modniir]] on the path to Justiciar Thommis.
